title: Dual therapeutic approach to modulate Glycogen Synthase kinase -3 beta (GSK-3Beta) and inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa kinase-beta (IKK-beta) receptors by in silico designing of inhibitors.
authors: Roy Acharyya, Suchandra; Sen, Plaboni; Kandasamy, Thirukumaran; Sankar Ghosh, Siddhartha
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟设计靶向GSK-3Beta和IKK-beta激酶的双靶点抑制剂，属于蛋白-小分子药物设计，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cancer malignancies require the application of advanced strategies leading to the development of novel theranostic. Quite often drugs target a variety of receptors in the cell signaling cascades that could be explored to combat aggressive tumors. Herein, two receptors that are over-expressed during the diagnosis of breast cancer are used as the primary drug targets, inclusively Glycogen Synthase kinase -3 beta (GSK-3Beta) and Inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa kinase-beta (IKK-beta). Dual-targeting inhibitors pave the way for a challenging pathway in the treatment of aberrant tumor progression. The present study involves the observation of similarities in the structure of the receptors, along with the designing of novel therapeutics that act on them by molecular docking followed by a pharmacokinetic screening approach. A 3D QSAR modeling study is performed to approach the functionality of the bioactive conformer molecules. Additionally, Molecular Dynamic Simulation parameters are used for the validation of the drug complexes. Already available inhibitors are used as reference compounds and a library of analogs generated for these compounds from the PubChem database has been used for in silico designing of novel inhibitors. Molecular Docking and ADME analysis narrowed down the vast library of compounds to two specific classes of chemical compounds. Molecular Dynamic simulation studies used for the selection of the novel moieties showed significant superiority in their stability studies and binding trajectories resulted in two novel molecules A6 and B3 that could inhibit the kinase receptors. The current work involves computational designing of therapeutics targeting two major oncogenic proteins.
abstract_zh: 癌症恶性肿瘤需要应用先进策略来开发新型诊疗制剂。药物通常靶向细胞信号级联中的多种受体，这些受体可被探索用于对抗侵袭性肿瘤。在此，乳腺癌诊断过程中过度表达的两种受体被用作主要药物靶点，包括糖原合成酶激酶-3β（GSK-3Beta）和核因子κB激酶抑制剂-β（IKK-beta）。双靶点抑制剂为治疗异常肿瘤进展开辟了一条具有挑战性的途径。本研究涉及观察受体结构的相似性，并通过分子对接及随后的药代动力学筛选方法设计作用于这些受体的新型治疗药物。采用三维定量构效关系（3D QSAR）建模研究来探讨生物活性构象分子的功能。此外，利用分子动力学模拟参数对药物复合物进行验证。已有抑制剂作为参考化合物，并从PubChem数据库中为这些化合物生成类似物库，用于新型抑制剂的计算机模拟设计。分子对接和ADME分析将庞大的化合物库缩小至两类特定化学化合物。用于选择新型分子的分子动力学模拟研究显示其在稳定性研究中的显著优越性，结合轨迹产生了两种能够抑制激酶受体的新型分子A6和B3。当前工作涉及针对两种主要致癌蛋白的治疗药物的计算设计。
